text:
The Calder Strait Ferry Authority's new Isolde-class vessel entered service on the Varnholm–Ostrel route on 14 March 2031, carrying up to 650 passengers and 90 vehicles.

The capacity figure is set out in the Authority's Certificate of Passenger Capacity, Ref. CSFA-IS-0412, which was issued after the ship's final safety inspection. Captain Marguerite Tolliver, the Authority's Fleet Operations Director, confirmed the number at the launch briefing.

The lead vessel of the class measures 128 meters in length. The passenger limit of 650 is the maximum permitted under the certificate and applies to each crossing.

The ship is the first of its class to enter commercial operation. Captain Tolliver said the certificate's figures would govern how the vessel is operated on the route.

No other figures from the certificate were given at the briefing.
